# Staff Engineer Interview

> What changes at staff level: the loop, system design at staff scope, the project deep dive, and down-leveling. A free guide from DesignGurus.io, in plain Markdown, with no account required.

Each page is short and ends with links to full course lessons and free articles. Each description below is the opening sentence of that page.

## Cheat sheets

- [Common Mistakes in Staff Engineer Interviews](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/common-mistakes.md): Strong senior engineers fail staff loops for a small number of repeated reasons.
- [Down-Leveling](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/down-leveling.md): Down-leveling is an offer one level below the level you interviewed for.
- [Four-Week Staff Engineer Interview Plan](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/four-week-plan.md): This plan assumes 8 to 10 hours per week and an engineer who already works at senior level.
- [Staff Engineer Levels at Large Companies](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/levels.md): Staff engineer is the first level above senior engineer on the individual contributor track.
- [Staff Engineer Interview Questions](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/question-bank.md): This page lists 50 questions that staff engineer candidates commonly report, in seven groups.

## Rounds

- [The Staff Engineer Behavioral Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/rounds/behavioral.md): A staff behavioral round asks the same kinds of questions as a senior one, about conflict, failure, and ambiguity.
- [The Staff Engineer Coding Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/rounds/coding.md): Most staff loops still include one coding round, and some include two.
- [The Staff Engineer Interview Loop](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/rounds/interview-loop.md): A staff engineer loop usually has three stages: a recruiter call, one or two screens, and an onsite of four or five rounds.
- [The Project Deep Dive Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/rounds/project-deep-dive.md): The project deep dive is a 45 to 60 minute round about one project from your own history.
- [The Staff Engineer System Design Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/rounds/system-design.md): A senior design round asks for a system that works at the stated scale.

## Skills

- [Influence Without Authority](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/skills/influence-without-authority.md): A staff engineer usually has no direct reports and cannot instruct another team to do anything.
- [Senior vs Staff Engineer](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/skills/senior-vs-staff.md): A staff engineer is not a faster senior engineer.
- [Staff Engineer Archetypes](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/skills/staff-archetypes.md): Staff engineer is one title that covers several different jobs.
- [Technical Judgment Under Uncertainty](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/skills/technical-judgment.md): Technical judgment is the ability to make a sound decision before all the information is available.
- [Technical Strategy and Design Docs](https://github.com/design-gurus/staff-engineer-interview/blob/main/skills/technical-strategy-and-design-docs.md): Most of a staff engineer's influence travels through writing.
